question: What is the objective of the KUSUM programme launched by the Indian government?

options.text: Promotion of organic farming in the country
Providing financial security to farmers through harnessing solar energy capacities
Starts ups for women and youth

solution:
The correct answer is __**Providing financial security to farmers through harnessing solar energy capacities**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The KUSUM scheme, launched by the Indian government, aims to support farmers in installing solar pumps and other renewable power generation setups.
